pixels._note: Approved snippets. tracking stays false and clickcease_id stays empty so the footer demo does not load a second gtm.js or stat.js. faq.q: What types of properties do you buy?
faq.a: Single-family houses and multi-family properties (2–4 units), in any condition: inherited homes, houses with liens or judgments, homes needing repairs, vacant houses, properties behind on taxes, and hoarder houses. We do not buy mobile/manufactured homes, condos, townhouses, apartments, or vacant land.

Every property is reviewed by a person, not an algorithm. A cash offer is typically below full retail value because we take on repairs, closing costs, and risk. If a cash offer isn't your best option, we'll also show you a market-sale option that may net you more.
Usually 10–14 business days in most scenarios. If you need more time, we close on the date you choose.
No commissions or hidden fees on our cash offer, and we cover closing costs.
Often, if there is enough time before the sale date. Read the options. We are not attorneys; for legal advice, talk with a foreclosure attorney or a HUD-approved housing counselor.

faq.q: Do I have to clean or make repairs?
faq.a: No. Sell as-is. Leave what you don't want; we handle cleanup.
You're free to say no. There's no cost to get an offer and no pressure to accept it.
Yes. Fair & Simple Home Offer is operated by Andrew Collier LLC, holds an A+ BBB rating, and is 5-star rated on Google and Facebook. Always compare offers. We encourage it.
